experiences.title: Marketing Operations Analyst (GTM)
experiences.description:
Analyzed website traffic, user engagement, and conversion funnels using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), combining campaign performance data with Power BI dashboards to identify drop-off points and optimize marketing reporting
Developed self-service Power BI and Tableau dashboards on multi-source data that track KPIs across 5+ reporting workflows, replacing manual report preparation
Shortened reporting turnaround 25% by leading requirements workshops that aligned stakeholders on KPI definitions, then converting them into Power BI report specifications
Established end-to-end metric traceability by auditing data sources and documenting each dashboard's lineage
